title: Consequential Action Interoperability Project — 25 Candidate Mappings
claim_boundary: A mapping result is content correlation under a pinned profile; it is not authorization.
INDETERMINATE is an expected fail-closed result when a mechanism does not expose every material action field.
The optional carry profile is a proposed composition path, not a claim that the source draft defines or endorses CAID.
Authorization audience and trust context remain outside this action identifier; target identifies where the material action occurs.
No author participation, validation, implementation, adoption, or endorsement is claimed.

selection_policy.criteria: Consequential-action relevance, protocol diversity, and a reviewable action or evidence boundary.
selection_policy.excluded_contacts: Authors excluded by project-owner direction are enforced by tests and are not named in this public artifact.

local_action_definition.summary: A profile-bounded consequential action used only by this interoperability project.
local_action_definition.digest_notes: Operation, target, and complete material parameters are material under this local profile. Authorization audience remains verifier context.

mappings.title: AI Agent Authentication and Authorization
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: Missions, OAuth delegation, transaction tokens, and human confirmation are described, while mission translation remains out of scope.

author_review.request: Please check whether the audit action/resource and transaction-token audience are the right extraction points, and whether a normative parameter commitment exists.

mappings.title: OAuth 2.0 AI Agent Instance Profile
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The profile binds agent-instance and delegation evidence, but not a complete consequential action target and parameter set.

author_review.request: Please check whether any profile claim can supply a stable target and parameter commitment without treating agent identity as action authority.

mappings.title: A SCITT Profile for AI-Agent Action Receipts
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The receipt carries action identity, a canonical risk-table key, parameter commitment, and tenant-scoped chain context.

author_review.request: Please check whether action.id is the correct material target and whether action.paramsHash should be mapped directly rather than re-derived from disclosed parameters.

mappings.title: Workload Identity in a Multi System Environment (WIMSE) Architecture
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The architecture separates authentication from authorization and intentionally leaves message-level authorization formats out of scope.

author_review.request: Please check whether a WIMSE security-context profile is the correct place to carry an external exact-action reference.

mappings.title: WIMSE Workload-to-Workload Authentication with HTTP Signatures
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The profile covers the request method and target, Content-Digest for bodies, audience, freshness, nonce, and request-response binding.

author_review.request: Please check whether the covered HTTP method, target URI, body representation, and wimse-aud are sufficient material fields for an HTTP-action mapping.

mappings.title: WIMSE Workload Credentials
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The draft establishes workload identity and proof-of-possession context, not an exact consequential action.

author_review.request: Please check whether the credential should remain actor context only and point to an external action object.

mappings.title: WIMSE Workload Proof Token
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The token binds workload proof and request context, but unprotected request material and middleboxes limit exact-action coverage.

author_review.request: Please check which request components are guaranteed protected and whether a body or parameter commitment belongs in a companion profile.

mappings.title: Security Principal and Verifier Binding for Agent Communication Protocols
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The draft defines composition slots and negative tests but intentionally does not instantiate a concrete action wire object.

author_review.request: Please check whether this neutral extraction/carry split matches the verifier-matrix intent without privileging any protocol.

mappings.title: OAuth Transaction Authorization Challenge
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The signed challenge carries transaction identity and RAR authorization details describing the challenged operation.

author_review.request: Please check whether the first RAR item is a valid single-action extraction or whether profiles must reject multi-item challenges as indeterminate.

mappings.title: Delegation Receipt Protocol for AI Agent Authorization
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The receipt binds structured operations, resources, boundaries, timing, and signed pre-execution scope.

author_review.request: Please check whether scope.resources and boundaries fully determine one consequential action or require an additional per-execution action commitment.

mappings.title: Intent Admission Assertions for Agentic Systems
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The assertion binds canonical intent, admitted action/resource scope, constraints, audience, and presenter proof before execution.

author_review.request: Please check whether one ActionRef should cover a single action/resource pair and how multi-action admissions should be split or rejected.

mappings.title: Transaction Tokens For Agents
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.locator: Transaction Token claims and multi-agent examples
evidence.finding: The token carries subject, actor, scope, and transaction context; the exact parameter commitment is not uniformly defined.

author_review.request: Please check whether transaction context can normatively expose exact parameters or should carry an external action digest.

mappings.title: Transaction-Bound Authorization Tokens for Software and AI Agents (SPT-Txn)
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: Intent is defined by tool, target, and parameters with JCS-based canonicalization and SHA-256 digest checking.

author_review.request: Please check whether audience is material to action identity or should remain verifier context outside the CAID projection.

mappings.title: OAuth Actor Profile for Delegation
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The profile standardizes actor representation and propagation while leaving actor permissions and action semantics deployment-specific.

author_review.request: Please check whether act-chain claims should remain authenticated actor context and reference a separate action object.

mappings.title: A Layered Requirements Mapping for Cross-Organization Agent Delegation
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The requirements model joins evidence by action digest but does not define the canonical action object that produced that digest.

author_review.request: Please check whether the shared digest should carry a profile identifier so different canonicalizers cannot appear equivalent.

mappings.title: Selective Disclosure Profile for Agent Action Capsules
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: Selective disclosure can omit fields; verification must distinguish intentionally undisclosed material from absent material.

author_review.request: Please check which action fields must be disclosed before an exact-action equivalence result is permitted.

mappings.title: AI Agent Execution Profile of SCITT
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The AIR profile preserves execution and custody evidence but does not require a complete pre-execution parameter commitment.

author_review.request: Please check whether intent_attestation or a companion reference is the right home for a canonical exact-action commitment.

mappings.title: Permit Receipts for Permit-Before-Commit Authorization of AI-Agent and Workload External Effects
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: ORPRG binds the full canonical external-effect request through action_digest or action_commitment under an identified canonicalization profile. Revision -00 does not define a profile-independent decomposition into operation, target_ref, and parameters_digest; that projection requires a selected effect-specific profile and the verified canonical request.

mappings.native_profile_role: Executable fail-closed probe. The reserved /__caid_unavailable__/* paths are deliberately absent from the fixture and are not fields defined by ORPRG revision -00.

author_review.scope: Revision -00 and this narrow mapping disposition only; not validation of the CAID harness or broader interoperability pack, and not implementation, adoption, or endorsement.
author_review.finding: The profile-independent result remains PARTIAL to INDETERMINATE. Policy epoch and authorization audience remain verifier context outside material action identity, while a material effect recipient remains inside the selected action profile.
author_review.request: Please check the canonical effect-request field projection and whether policy epoch belongs outside action identity.

mappings.title: Principal Agent Protocol (PAP)
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: PAP binds a principal-rooted mandate and single-use capability token to a structured action scope.

author_review.request: Please check whether the capability action object has a stable target and parameter representation across PAP profiles.

mappings.title: Agent Passport System (APS): Verifiable Agent Identity, Faceted Authority, and Signed Action Receipts
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: ActionRefV2 commits to the requested action and payload under a named profile with single-use admission state.

author_review.request: Please check the ActionRefV2 projection and whether principal identity is intentionally inside or outside the action reference.

mappings.title: vCon Agent Session
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The signed session envelope can record tool activity but does not require exact material fields for every consequential call.

author_review.request: Please check whether a consequential tool-call attachment should require an action profile and parameters digest.

mappings.title: AgentOps Observability for Failure Detection and Attribution
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The event envelope covers actors, phases, causal links, and evidence references but not a mandatory exact parameter projection.

author_review.request: Please check which event attributes are stable enough for exact-action extraction without exposing sensitive payloads.

mappings.title: Deployment Scenarios and Gap Analysis for AI Agent Gateway
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The draft identifies gateway exchange and action-level authorization for physical-world operations as requirements, but no concrete action artifact is defined.

author_review.request: Please check our reading of Sections 6.7 and 6.9: should a future DMSC profile carry a canonical action reference across gateway boundaries?

mappings.title: A Well-Known URI Profile for Agent-Callable Commerce Endpoints
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: Discovery identifies agent-callable commerce endpoints but leaves transaction authorization and exact invocation material to clients.

author_review.request: Please check whether a commerce entry should advertise an action-schema or CAID profile for the selected MCP tool.

mappings.title: Categorical Compliance Screening Receipt Format for Agentic-Payment Flows
mappings.source_kind: human-reviewed extraction fixture; not a native parser or implementation

evidence.finding: The receipt binds compliance evidence and chain linkage but is not itself an exact-action authorization object.

author_review.request: Please check whether the payment linkage contains a stable action commitment or should reference an external action identifier.
